clarifications.change: hard negatives exclude names identical to the anchor (a dry check of the training data showed HFR duplicates of the anchor's own name being drawn as negatives)

known_bias: T1 pairs were proposed by the engine's own name step (favours TF-IDF); T2 is engine-independent but HFR is partly compiled from GRID3

labels.note: includes 3 corrections made 2026-11-21 after a shared-source-id check

question: Does an encoder trained on the GRID3-HFR crosswalk of other states, or a facility-type tier normalisation, retrieve better than character TF-IDF on Nigerian facilities?

rule.gallery: every HFR facility name in the query's state (data/hfr_<state>.csv)

H1_encoder_transfer.shown: on T2: mean gain@10 >= 2 points AND paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0; AND on T1: lower bound > -2 points (no harm)

H3_union.arm: rrf(tfidf_char3_tier, fine_tuned:crosswalk seed0..2 mean of 3 runs), k=60

test_sets.T1: the 86 review-band pairs the maintainer marked same_entity (same labels file as the E0b transfer test)
test_sets.T2: every GRID3 v2 / HFR pair joined on globalid = global_id in Edo, Kano and Ondo whose names differ after case and space folding (independent of the engine)

tier_map_note: fixed from type-word swaps in training-state crosswalk pairs only, before any test ranking; longest phrase first; the phrase is removed and its tier word appended

training.config: TrainConfig defaults (2 epochs, batch 64, lr 2e-5, temperature 0.05)
training.hard_negatives: up to 3 HFR names in the same state and LGA, from the TF-IDF top 10 of the anchor, that are other facilities and whose folded name is neither the positive's nor the anchor's
training.pairs: GRID3 facility_name -> HFR name where they differ after folding, plus HFR name -> HFR alternate_name where they differ
training.states: the 34 GRID3 states other than Edo, Kano and Ondo (no test-state record is ever a positive or negative)
